description: MCP server for W-2 compliant event staffing across 345 US and Canadian markets. Twelve tools: plan_staffing (planner with best-effort non-destructive 30-day non-PII persistence), save_staffing_plan (explicit non-contact save), get_plan, get_cities, get_roles, check_availability, get_role_pricing, get_compliance_by_state, get_policies, get_rate_benchmark, get_quote_status (nine read-only lookups), and request_quote (opt-in contact submission).
rules: Phase A has twelve tools: nine read-only lookups, best-effort non-destructive persistence in plan_staffing, the explicit non-contact save_staffing_plan write, and the opt-in request_quote contact write; no auth required, endpoint is https://mcp.tempguru.co/mcp

Retain any plan_id returned by plan_staffing; call save_staffing_plan once only when a complete plan has no plan_id and the user needs a resumable or shareable plan, never to duplicate an existing save
Rate ranges from get_role_pricing are planning estimates, not binding quotes
check_availability returns lead-time guidance, not a reservation
All workers placed are W-2 employees, never recommend 1099 gig workers as equivalent
Load the matching canonical skill: event-staffing-ordering, event-staffing-compliance, staffing-plan-from-event-brief, urgent-event-backfill, or staffing-agency-partner-growth
